predecision_evidence: Prior CRL publicly identified the needed remediation as additional efficacy data; STRIDE 3 met both primary symptom endpoints and key secondary sign endpoint; FDA accepted the resubmission as a complete Class 2 response; KALA disclosed that EYSUVIS would use the same qualified cGMP facilities used for FDA-approved INVELTYS; no new unresolved FDA warning identified before action.

The 2021 CRL explicitly stated no safety, clinical pharmacology/biopharmaceutics, CMC or nonclinical issues; three Phase 3 trials had met primary/key secondary endpoints; FDA's Office of New Drugs granted Ardelyx's appeal and directed the review division to work with Ardelyx on an appropriate label; the advisory committee had voted that benefits outweighed risks; no new unresolved manufacturing/inspection blocker was identified in the predecision company record.

The February 2023 CRL identified the nitrosamine stability/control issue and the company stated no additional deficiencies were cited; the NDA was resubmitted as a complete Class 2 response; reformulated batches controlled NVP more than 10-fold below FDA's acceptable intake; six-month stability data were submitted before the PDUFA date and the company stated this satisfied FDA's additional-data request; labeling discussions were already near final.
